name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: You asked for 3 to 5 reasons I am a strong fit for this role, so here they are, directly.

1. Real, hands-on technical SEO depth. I run technical SEO audits, keyword gap analysis, and competitor research with Screaming Frog, and implement schema and structured data as standard practice, the same tools your team already uses.

2. A genuine bridge into GEO. I build AI agent logic and prompt design every day, translating business intent into structured LLM instructions and evaluating AI-generated output against rubrics I wrote myself. I have not run LLM citation-tracking as a formal deliverable yet, but I understand the mechanics of how content gets processed and surfaced by generative engines better than most SEO-only candidates will.

3. Quantified, real results. At Wix, I drove a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates managing a live client portfolio, not a single case study, a sustained book of accounts.
4. B2B SaaS and agency background across multiple employers, plus direct financial-services client experience at Fetch & Funnel, covering two of your three named verticals.

5. Proven autonomous execution. I have run client engagements solo end to end, research, strategy, content, and reporting, for the last two years as a founder, and cross-functionally with analysts, engineers, and product teams before that.
I would welcome the chance to bring all five of these to your clients.
